Homepage libraries are distributed locally to avoid third-party CDN requests.

Source: https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
License: MIT; see react-18.3.1.LICENSE.txt

ReactDOM 18.3.1 (production UMD build)
Source: https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js
License: MIT; see react-dom-18.3.1.LICENSE.txt

Babel standalone 7.26.10 (authoring compiler only; not requested by the browser)
Source: https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.26.10/babel.min.js
License: MIT; see babel-7.26.10.LICENSE.txt

Tailwind CSS browser runtime 3.4.17
Source: https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17
License: MIT; see tailwind-3.4.17.LICENSE.txt

Original distribution files and license notices are retained without modification.
